estimates.assumptions: 1-2 tbsp English mustard averages 1.5 tbsp; standard mustard density ~15 g/tbsp, so 22.5 g total. Calories based on typical Dijon-style mustard (~97 kcal/100 g).
'Dash' of olive oil for searing is a small amount for the pan; conservatively estimated at 10 g (about 2 tsp). Supplied knownCaloriesPer100g copied exactly.
'750g piece' of beef fillet is the full edible weight given; no trimming or bone loss assumed. Calories reflect typical raw beef tenderloin/fillet (~198 kcal/100 g).
6-8 slices Parma ham averaged to 7 slices; typical thin slice is ~17 g, so ~120 g total. Calories based on standard prosciutto/Parma values (~250 kcal/100 g).
'Dusting' of flour for rolling pastry is a modest sprinkling; estimated at 5 g. Supplied knownCaloriesPer100g copied exactly.
